Added the design documents behind the minds in-app notification system.

- `specs/minds-notification-integration.md`: background study of the minds-options prototype's notification design and how it maps onto the minds app (feed architecture, surfaces, suppression rules, delivery preferences, phased plan).

- `blueprint/minds-notification-system/plan-minds-notification-system.md`: the blueprint plan the implementation (in `apps/minds`) was built from -- wire contract, backend feed, chrome surfaces, testing strategy.
